candidates.original_title: Melanoma exosomes educate bone marrow progenitor cells toward a pro-metastatic phenotype through MET
candidates.description: Reduction of Met in B16-F10 exosomes by shRNA decreased lung and bone metastatic burden compared to control exosomes
candidates.citation_sentence: This experiment is similar to what was reported in Figure 4E of Peinado et al., 2012 and described in Protocol 3 in the Registered Report (Lesnik et al., 2016).
candidates.notes: The paper describes this as a direct replication. The experiment was stopped early (day 18 instead of planned day 21) due to animal deaths and large tumor sizes. Sample sizes were small (n=5-7 per group). The meta-analysis combining original and replication was also not significant. No statistically significant effect was found for metastatic burden in lungs or femurs; the authors report results in the same direction as the original but not statistically significant.
